validator-api-reference.text: A contributor can open each registry module's generated interface, follow its public declarations and inspect their source at the documentation build's exact revision. The reference is generated by the pinned Aiken compiler from the same source tree as this page.

open-a-module.text: The reference's index lists every documented module and searches its public members. These links open the generated pages on the site and the source files when read in the repository.

follow-a-rule.text: The state validator owners page maps creation, request handling, state recognition and token naming to their source owners. Test support appears in the reference because its helpers are public to test modules; it is not an additional product interface.
The documentation build generates the interface and binds its pages to source digests. Its checks reject a missing page, changed source or a source link to another revision.

coverage-limits.text: A module has a generated page when it declares a public definition. Test cases and a validator with no public declarations remain available in the source tree. The application's separate on-chain project has no generated reference on this site; that coverage gap remains explicit. Compilation and generated documentation do not establish validator behavior or ledger acceptance.
